capabilities: Convert the current line to a heading by typing a .#, .##, or .### suffix
Convert the current line to an unordered list item with .- or .+
Convert the current line to a blockquote with .>
Convert the current line to incomplete or completed task items with .[ ] or .[x]
Configure custom templates in the templates array
extras: README begins with an apparently truncated parenthetical ('This is a postfix plugin for Obsidian ('), so some introductory text or link may be missing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in postfix completions, so users must move the cursor to line start or use menus to apply Markdown formatting to text they already typed.
summary: Postfix completion plugin that converts the current line to Markdown formatting when you type a suffix like .## or .[ ] and press space.
